steps.title: Define App Metadata
steps.description: Configure the core application metadata, setting the name to 'Photo Resizer Pro' and creating the unique package namespace 'com.photoresizerpro.app'.

steps.title: Configure Build Settings
steps.description: Define compile target SDK, minimum SDK, target SDK versions, and strict Java 8 compilation compatibility properties in build.gradle.

steps.title: Configure Android Manifest
steps.description: Set up application permissions, default theme, and define MainActivity as the primary launcher activity inside AndroidManifest.xml.

steps.title: Design Main Application Layout
steps.description: Design the main interface with standard XML layouts, allowing users to pick images, adjust dimensions, toggle aspect ratios, choose formats, set quality, and trigger resizing.

steps.title: Implement Main Activity Setup
steps.description: Initialize main activity variables, locate views, bind initial action listeners, and prepare dynamic layout elements.

steps.title: Implement Image Loading Logic
steps.description: Develop safe asynchronous image loading from Uri to avoid OutOfMemory errors on large native camera or gallery images.

steps.title: Implement Dynamic Dimension Watchers
steps.description: Create aspect ratio calculations that dynamically synchronize the width and height inputs while respecting aspect ratio locks.

steps.title: Develop Background Resizing Engine
steps.description: Implement standard Android Canvas and Matrix scaling operations running on a background worker thread for fast, high-quality image scaling.

steps.title: Add Image Format and Quality Handling
steps.description: Integrate configuration adjustments for PNG, JPEG, and WEBP encoding along with compression quality slider values.

steps.title: Implement MediaStore Save Routine
steps.description: Implement modern Android MediaStore logic to safely persist resized images into the public Photos directory/Gallery without storage permission warnings.

steps.title: Implement Image Sharing Integration
steps.description: Add sharing functionality that lets users instantly send resized images to communication and cloud apps via the standard system share sheet.

steps.title: Building Photo Resizer Pro
steps.description: Assemble the project, check for XML validation rules, compile resources, and create the final high-performance debug package.
